Policies and Initiatives.title: Andhra Pradesh to become 'India's first' AI-powered tourism state
Policies and Initiatives.summary: Andhra Pradesh is set to become India's first AI-powered tourism state through a new initiative. The state's tourism development corporation has signed a three-year MoU with Xplore to implement the AI-powered tourism project. This partnership aims to enhance the state's tourism sector using artificial intelligence.

Policies and Initiatives.title: Andhra govt to launch Amaravati Quantum & AI Innovation Center
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Andhra Pradesh government is launching the Amaravati Quantum & AI Innovation Center in partnership with IBM. The center aims to create a large-scale quantum innovation ecosystem, connecting industry, academia, and technology experts. The initiative will focus on developing practical quantum computing solutions through collaboration and innovation.

Policies and Initiatives.title: A.P. Cabinet clears AI data projects in Visakhapatnam, Anakapalli districts
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet has approved AI data projects in Visakhapatnam and Anakapalli districts. An Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Testing facility will also be established in Sri Sathya Sai district. These approvals aim to promote the development of AI and semiconductor industries in the region.

Policies and Initiatives.title: A.P. Cabinet clears ₹2,388-crore semiconductor facility at Tarluvada
Policies and Initiatives.summary: The Andhra Pradesh Cabinet has approved a ₹2,388-crore semiconductor facility at Tarluvada. A total of 601.4 acres will be allotted for the project, which includes a 1,000 MW AI data centre cluster. The project will be implemented through three Special Purpose Vehicles in Visakhapatnam and Anakapalli districts.

Major AI Developments.title: ISRO-NRSC study uses satellite data, AI to map soil health in Andhra farmland
Major AI Developments.summary: ISRO-NRSC conducted a study that utilized satellite data and AI to map soil health in Andhra farmland. The study aimed to assess and improve soil health using advanced technologies. Satellite data and AI were combined to create detailed maps of soil health, providing valuable insights for farmers and policymakers.

Major AI Developments.title: Aramco Ventures leads $9.5 Mn funding in climate tech startup Mitti Labs
Major AI Developments.summary: Aramco Ventures has led a $9.5 million funding round in climate tech startup Mitti Labs, with participation from existing and new investors. Mitti Labs had previously raised $3 million and plans to use the fresh funds to expand across India and enter new markets in the Philippines and Indonesia. The startup, co-founded in 2023, aims to further its climate-focused initiatives with the new investment.

Major AI Developments.title: Andhra govt, Google to form joint Task Force for collaboration in AI,...
Major AI Developments.summary: The Andhra government is partnering with Google to form a joint Task Force for collaboration in artificial intelligence. This partnership aims to leverage AI technology for various applications, although specific details are not provided. The joint Task Force will facilitate cooperation and innovation between the two entities.

Major AI Developments.title: AI-assisted eye screening begins at GGH in Guntur
Major AI Developments.summary: An AI-assisted eye screening pilot project has begun at Guntur's GGH, aiming to screen around 9,000 people for diabetic retinopathy over three months. The project will be extended to Kurnool and Visakhapatnam this month as part of its expansion. The initiative uses AI technology to detect diabetic retinopathy, a common complication of diabetes.

Major AI Developments.title: Uber to set up its first India data centre with Adani Group
Major AI Developments.summary: Uber is setting up its first data centre in India in partnership with Adani Group, deepening its technology and infrastructure footprint in the country. The development was announced by Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi after meeting Gautam Adani in Ahmedabad. The facility will enable Uber to test and deploy technology at scale from India for its global operations.

Major AI Developments.title: Google’s AI Hub in Visakhapatnam; Building the missing pipeline for women founders
Major AI Developments.summary: Google has launched an AI hub in Visakhapatnam, a key step in India's development of large-scale digital infrastructure. The hub aims to support the country's economic growth through AI technology. Additionally, Rebalance, a Gurugram-based organization, is providing support to women-led startups through mentorship and investor access.

Major AI Developments.title: Google’s $15 bn AI hub in Vizag will be growth engine for Indian economy: Naidu
Major AI Developments.summary: Google is investing $15 billion in an AI hub in Vizag, which is expected to drive growth in the Indian economy. According to Naidu, this hub will serve as a key growth engine for the country. The investment is anticipated to have a significant impact on India's economic development.

Major AI Developments.title: Google lays foundation of Rs 1.4 lakh cr AI data centre in Visakhapatnam; India gets biggest FDI in tech history
Major AI Developments.summary: Google has laid the foundation for a $15 billion AI data centre in Visakhapatnam, equivalent to Rs 1.4 lakh crore. This investment marks India's largest-ever foreign direct investment (FDI) in the tech sector. The data centre is expected to be a significant development in India's tech history.

Major AI Developments.title: Google breaks ground on AI Hub in Visakhapatnam
Major AI Developments.summary: Google has begun construction on an AI Hub in Visakhapatnam, a key part of its plan to create a gigawatt-scale AI ecosystem in India. The project is part of the company's $15 billion investment in India over five years. This investment aims to establish a significant AI presence in the country.

Major AI Developments.title: AI engineering jobs in India surge 59.5 pc, outpacing US and Europe: LinkedIn report
Major AI Developments.summary: AI engineering job postings in India increased by 59.5% year-over-year, surpassing growth in the US and Europe. This surge is driven by strong demand in cities like Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and emerging cities such as Vijayawada. The growth reflects rapid adoption of AI across various industries in India, according to a LinkedIn report.

Major AI Developments.title: Quiet Tarluvada readies for Google AI data centre
Major AI Developments.summary: Google is set to build its first hyperscale 1 GW AI data centre outside the United States in the hamlet of Tarluvada, located near Visakhapatnam. The data centre will be a major facility, marking a significant investment by the tech giant. The foundation stone for the project is scheduled to be laid on April 28.

Major AI Developments.title: Andhra Pradesh offers vast scope in AI, robotics, automation, and electric mobility, says Industries  Minister T.G. Bharat
Major AI Developments.summary: Andhra Pradesh's Industries Minister T.G. Bharat believes the state has significant potential in AI, robotics, automation, and electric mobility. The Minister is exploring opportunities for industrial partnerships and technological collaboration in Germany. This initiative aims to leverage international expertise to drive growth in these key sectors in Andhra Pradesh.

Major AI Developments.title: Andhra Pradesh explores Artificial Intelligence-based cultural tourism initiatives
Major AI Developments.summary: The Andhra Pradesh Tourism Department is partnering with Eros Innovation to explore AI-based cultural tourism initiatives. This collaboration aims to connect culture, digital innovation, and tourism through technological partnerships. The initiative seeks to leverage AI to enhance the state's cultural tourism offerings.

Major AI Developments.title: Vizag to roll out AI driven traffic management systems
Major AI Developments.summary: Vizag is set to implement an AI-driven traffic management system with over 2,000 high-end cameras across 102 junctions. The cameras will be installed at 56 corridors, including RK Beach Road, to enhance surveillance. The project is valued at Rs 60-65 crore.

Major AI Developments.title: BJYM condemns Youth Congress conduct at AI Summit
Major AI Developments.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha (BJYM) protested in Ongole and Tirupati against the Youth Congress's conduct at an AI summit. The protests were sparked by a shirtless demonstration during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's inauguration of the international summit in New Delhi. The BJYM burned an effigy of Rahul Gandhi as part of their protest.

Major AI Developments.title: Andhra to sign agreements to strengthen AI infrastructure at New Delhi summit
Major AI Developments.summary: Andhra is set to sign agreements to strengthen its AI infrastructure at a summit in New Delhi. The agreements aim to enhance the state's artificial intelligence capabilities. The summit will facilitate partnerships to boost Andhra's AI ecosystem.

Major AI Developments.title: AI Impact Summit: Pichai bets $15 billion on India’s AI future, calls it the ‘biggest platform shift’
Major AI Developments.summary: Sundar Pichai announced Google's $15 billion investment in India's AI future at the AI Impact Summit. The investment will include the establishment of a Vizag AI hub and a focus on responsible AI. This move aims to power jobs, infrastructure, and public services in India, which Pichai described as the "biggest platform shift".

Major AI Developments.title: Google to lay new undersea cable routes between US and India: CEO Sundar Pichai
Major AI Developments.summary: Google is investing in a new undersea cable route between the US and India, according to CEO Sundar Pichai. The project is part of a $15 billion AI hub in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, which will also feature a gigawatt-scale compute facility. The hub will include an international subsea cable gateway, enhancing global connectivity.

Major AI Developments.title: Andhra Pradesh partnering with Gates Foundation to drive AI-led healthcare reforms: Health Minister
Major AI Developments.summary: Andhra Pradesh is partnering with the Gates Foundation to implement AI-led healthcare reforms. The state's Health Minister announced the collaboration, aiming to drive healthcare improvements through artificial intelligence. This partnership is expected to enhance the state's healthcare system using AI technology.

Major AI Developments.title: SGPC’s AI panel discusses ways to curb information misuse on Sikh religion
Major AI Developments.summary: AI experts discussed ways to prevent the spread of misinformation about Sikhism on social media through the misuse of AI. The discussion was part of an SGPC AI panel meeting, which aimed to mitigate the negative impact of AI on the Sikh religion. The SGPC also distributed Rs 43 lakh in educational funds to support the Siklighar and Vanjara communities in Andhra Pradesh.

Major AI Developments.title: Union Minister lauds State’s education reforms at AI Conclave in Delhi
Major AI Developments.summary: Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan attended an AI Conclave in Delhi, where he praised Andhra Pradesh's education reforms. He visited a special stall set up by the Andhra Pradesh School Education Department, showcasing the state's initiatives. The event highlighted the state's efforts in transforming its education system.

Major AI Developments.title: RMZ Group to Invest $10 Billion in GCC Park, Data Centre in Andhra Pradesh
Major AI Developments.summary: RMZ Group is investing $10 billion in a GCC Park and data centre in Andhra Pradesh. The projects are expected to create around 100,000 jobs across various sectors, including IT services, data centres, industrial, and logistics. This significant investment aims to boost employment and economic growth in the region.

AI Start-Up News.title: Aquapulse raises Rs 25 Cr in Series A led by NABVENTURES
AI Start-Up News.summary: Aquapulse, an aquaculture tech startup, has raised Rs 25 crore in a Series A round led by NABVENTURES. The funds will be used to expand its farmer network, set up a processing facility, and enhance its technology stack, including AI-led systems. Founded in 2022, Aquapulse aims to improve efficiency in the seafood value chain through its operations in aquaculture, infrastructure, and technology.

AI Start-Up News.title: Prashant Pitti’s Optimo Capital raises Rs 100 Cr from PNB
AI Start-Up News.summary: Optimo Capital, a tech-led NBFC, has raised Rs 100 crore in debt funding from Punjab National Bank and partnered with Godrej Finance to co-lend Rs 200 crore over 12 months. This development comes six months after the company secured Rs 150 crore in equity funding led by Blume Ventures and Omnivore. Optimo Capital focuses on MSME lending, offering digital secured loan-against-property products to borrowers with limited access to formal credit.

AI Start-Up News.title: Andhra Pradesh positions itself as IT and GCC hub, eyes Eastern Gateway status
AI Start-Up News.summary: Andhra Pradesh is positioning itself as a hub for IT and Global Capability Centers (GCC), with Visakhapatnam projected to become a key cluster for IT, GCC, and AI. The state already operates six seaports and plans to have four new greenfield ports operational within two years. This development aims to establish Andhra Pradesh as the Eastern Gateway, enhancing its economic and technological presence.
